name: Sterling Green Woods Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Sterling Greenwoods Ltd is in the business of Real Estate and Resorts.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Verticals:
a) Plotted Developments:[1]
The company offers plots, on Net Carpet Area, ranging from 150 to 500 sq. yards, designed to suit varied budget segments. It has completed ~50 projects which are situated on naturally elevated land, ensuring zero water logging issues.
b) Resort:[2]
The company is in the resort business viz.
The Greenwoods Lake Resort. This resort 
is situated on either side of an artificial lake connected by a bridge and is only one of 
its kind in Ahmedabad. The resort provides rooms, fine dining, banquets & conferences, 
party lawns, swimming pool, etc.
